titles.title: I Got a Confession From the Director
The Elite CEO Falls for His Personal Secretary!
エリート社長は専属秘書がお好き!?

description:
As an exclusive personal secretary, Lee Yunseo has supported Kang Seongha, the young CEO of Hoo Sports, for the past year. Unmarried and impeccably handsome, Seongha rose to the position of CEO at a young age and was almost like a celebrity within the company—an “idol,” even. Though rumors swirled around him—such as an alleged romance with an actress—and he carried an air of mystery, Yunseo genuinely respected him as her boss: he was exceptionally capable, and she took pride in working by his side. But one day, after Seongha returned from an overseas business trip and they wrapped up yet another hectic workday as usual… as Yunseo was heading out, she ran into the CEO face-to-face, and he suddenly said: “Let’s date, Yunseo.” Yunseo was left speechless…
